title: Volume Discount on ClearPath Standard Upgrades
content:
**Discount clause.** The upgrade volume discount on the upgraded rate of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement moving from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard reads the covered seats on the seat ledger (every seat addition less every seat removal). The discount is graduated: each covered seat from the 25th up to the 49th earns 2.0 percent, each covered seat from the 50th up earns 4.0 percent, and the earned percentages are summed and divided by the covered seats to give the percentage taken off; with fewer than 25 covered seats nothing is taken off.

**Worked figures (hypothetical covered seats).**

| Covered seats | Seats at 2.0 | Seats at 4.0 | Percentage off |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24 | none | none | nothing |
| 25 | 1 | none | 2.0 divided by 25, that is 0.08 percent |
| 30 | 6 | none | 12 divided by 30, that is 0.4 percent |
| 49 | 25 | none | 50 divided by 49, about 1.0204 percent |
| 60 | 25 | 11 | 50 plus 44, that is 94, divided by 60, about 1.5667 percent |
